title: Coproducts and derived evaluation for strict systems
statement:
For any sheaf-ring sequence B on the stated essentially small site, both the strict-system category and each coefficient-level category have arbitrary w-small coproducts, as do their unbounded derived categories. Evaluation preserves ordinary and derived coproducts for every w-small indexing set, including the empty set.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w})
theorem derivedSystemEvaluation_coproducts (n : ℕ) (I : Type w) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) (derivedSystemEvaluation B n)
```

proof.text: Componentwise construction gives ordinary coproducts and exact evaluation. The Grothendieck property supplies K-injective resolutions for the system and level categories. Apply the existing Grothendieck derived coproduct construction, and the exact derived functor preservation theorem, to each evaluation.
